title: Assistant Designer – Jewelry
note: Supports fine and fashion jewelry design; asks for 1–2 years of jewelry design experience.

facts.summary: Assistant designer on Centric's jewelry design team.
facts.duties: Trend research and mood boards, CADs and sketches in Illustrator/Rhino/Matrix, presentation decks and line sheets, track samples and vendor approvals.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's in jewelry or industrial design or related, 1–2 years jewelry design experience, Illustrator; jewelry CAD a plus.
facts.apply: Apply on Centric Brands' iCIMS careers site.
